CPU = ALU + control unit + registers; memory hierarchy: registers → cache → main memory (RAM) → secondary storage; buses: address, data, control
von Neumann: one memory and bus for program and data; Harvard: separate program and data memories (faster — DSPs, microcontrollers); RISC (few, simple instructions) vs CISC
